title: Extension Increments on the Builder Extended Rate Lock
content:
A Builder Extended Rate Lock is extended in increments of the term's increment days, in calendar days, added to the current lock expiration date.

## Rule

- An extension adds whole increments to the **current** lock expiration date.
- Over the life of the lock, extensions never exceed the term's maximum number of increments, nor the term's maximum total extension days. Both limits are measured on the lock record: the extension increments written on the lock and the total extension days written on it.
- An extension is written only on a lock whose status is locked. The status on the lock record is the authority, read for the lock being extended.
- An expired lock cannot be extended and may only be relocked.

## Retired clauses

> Each increment carries an extension fee of the term's extension fee percent of the loan amount, rounded half up to the cent, with a floor of the term's minimum extension fee; where the term's first increment carries no fee, the first increment on the lock carries a fee of zero.

> When the extension is needed because the purchase agreement's closing date moved for a builder delay, the term's builder-delay waiver percent of the extension charge is waived under the builder-delay waiver rule.

Both clauses are **no longer in force**; each is superseded by the current basis for the extension charge and for the builder-delay waiver respectively.

## Basis questions

**Can a lock in status requested be extended?** No. An extension is written only on a lock whose status is locked.

**What happens to a lock whose status is expired?** It cannot be extended and may only be relocked.

**Hypothetical: a term with 7-day increments, a limit of 3 increments and 21 total days; the lock has used 2 increments and 14 days.** One more increment of 7 days fits both limits; a request for two more increments would exceed both.

**Does an extension start from the original expiration date?** No. Each increment is added to the lock expiration date as it currently stands.

superseded_clauses: Each increment carries an extension fee of extension_fee_pct_per_increment percent of the loan amount, rounded half up to the cent, with a floor of extension_fee_min_usd; where first_extension_free is true the first increment on the lock carries a fee of zero.

When the extension is needed because the purchase agreement's closing date moved for a builder delay, builder_delay_waiver_pct percent of the extension charge is waived under lock_builder_delay_waiver.
